verdict.rationale: Daytona's Computer Use docs describe programmatic control of desktop environments inside sandboxes, covering mouse, keyboard, screenshots, screen recording and display operations for GUI automation and desktop-app testing. VM sandboxes with a full Linux or Windows OS also exist. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running a headless browser (e.g., Playwright/Chromium) in the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the desktop capability.
